content:
What to do when you do not know what to do? I know what to do when the doing takes some things to do instead of doing only that which has nothing to do with what you are supposed to do!

The supposedly supposed supposition of this superposed supine summary that supports my super powers is supposed to be true.

The truth lies in telling what you believe is true for all questions that are also true, unless ‘your’ truth fails to uncover ‘the’ truth and ‘the’ truth fails to be discovered by ‘some’ truth and ‘a’ truth will never be masked by ‘one’ truth that seemingly falls into the category of a LIE.

 

sick :P
